title: A Visit to the Old Town
text:
Today we found a brochure about the Old Town museum in our hotel. The brochure says the museum is open every day from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon. It also says that a ticket costs ten euros, but children enter for free.

The brochure has a map on the back. It shows the castle, the market square, and a small park next to the river. The map is very useful because the streets in the Old Town are narrow and it is easy to get lost.

questions.text: What time does the museum open?
What is on the back of the brochure?
Why is the map useful for visitors?
options: Because the hotel is far away
Because the streets are narrow and it is easy to get lost
Because the museum is free for everyone

questions.text: What can we guess about the brochure?
options: It was written for people visiting the Old Town
It was written for people who live in the castle
It was written only for museum workers
It was written for people who want to buy a house

vocabulary.definition: a small booklet with information for visitors
a small piece of paper that allows you to enter a place
a drawing that shows roads and places

paragraph_translations: Dzisiaj znaleźliśmy w naszym hotelu broszurę o muzeum w Starym Mieście. Broszura mówi, że muzeum jest otwarte codziennie od dziewiątej rano do piątej po południu. Pisze też, że bilet kosztuje dziesięć euro, ale dzieci wchodzą za darmo.
Na odwrocie broszury jest mapa. Pokazuje zamek, rynek i mały park nad rzeką. Mapa jest bardzo przydatna, ponieważ ulice w Starym Mieście są wąskie i łatwo się w nich zgubić.
